text: The Borrower may prepay all or part of the loan at any time without penalty, provided that the Lender gives the Borrower at least 15 days' prior written notice.
description: The notice obligation has been reversed. The original requires the Borrower to give the Lender 15 days' notice; the rewrite makes the Lender give notice to the Borrower. This is an error.

text: The Borrower shall repay the loan in 6 equal monthly instalments of EUR 14,500.00 each, excluding interest, with the first instalment due on March 31, 2026, and the final instalment due on August 31, 2026.
description: "including principal and interest" has become "excluding interest". This means interest is now payable on top of the instalments, which changes the repayment scope. This is an error.

text: The Lender agrees to advance to the Borrower a principal amount of EUR 85,000.00, which shall be disbursed in a single transfer to the Borrower's designated bank account within 5 calendar days of the signing of this Agreement.
description: "business days" has been translated as "calendar days", which shortens the disbursement period. This is an error.

text: The outstanding principal shall bear interest at a fixed annual rate of 7.25%, calculated on the basis of a 360-day year and accrued daily from the date of disbursement. No interest shall accrue during the first month following disbursement.
description: A sentence has been added that waives interest for the first month. It is not in the source. This is an error.

text: If any instalment remains unpaid for more than 10 days after its due date, the Borrower shall pay a late-payment charge of 2% of the overdue amount.
description: The clause allowing the Lender to declare the entire outstanding balance immediately due and payable (acceleration) has been deleted. This is an error.

text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Spain, and any dispute arising out of it shall be submitted to the competent courts of Madrid.
description: "arising from it" has been changed to "arising out of it". The meaning is identical. This is not an error.

text: This Short-Term Business Loan Agreement is entered into on February 9, 2026, between Harbourline Capital Ltd. (the "Lender") and Verdant Kitchenware S.L. (the "Borrower"), represented by Elena Marquez, its managing director.
description: The appositive has been reordered, putting the name before the title. The meaning is identical. This is not an error.

text: El Prestamista se compromete a entregar al Prestatario un importe principal de 85.000,00 EUR, que se desembolsará mediante una o varias transferencias a la cuenta bancaria designada por el Prestatario en un plazo de 5 días hábiles a partir de la firma del presente Contrato.
description: "una única transferencia" (a single transfer) has become "una o varias transferencias" (one or more transfers). This changes the disbursement terms. This is an error.

text: El Prestatario podrá amortizar anticipadamente la totalidad o parte del préstamo en cualquier momento con penalización, siempre que notifique por escrito al Prestamista con una antelación mínima de 15 días.
description: "sin penalización" (without penalty) has become "con penalización" (with penalty). This reverses the prepayment term. This is an error.

text: El Prestamista se compromete a entregar al Prestatario un importe principal de 85.000,00 EUR, que se desembolsará mediante una única transferencia a la cuenta bancaria designada por el Prestatario en un plazo de 5 días naturales a partir de la firma del presente Contrato.
description: "días hábiles" (business days) has been replaced with "días naturales" (calendar days). This is an error.

text: El Prestatario reembolsará el préstamo en 6 cuotas mensuales iguales de 14.500,00 EUR cada una, que incluyen principal e intereses, venciendo la primera cuota el 31 de marzo de 2026 y la última el 31 de agosto de 2026. Las cuotas se cargarán automáticamente mediante domiciliación bancaria en la cuenta del Prestatario.
description: A sentence has been added requiring automatic direct debit of the instalments. It is not in the source. This is an error.

text: Si alguna cuota permanece impagada durante más de 10 días después de su fecha de vencimiento, el Prestatario abonará un recargo por demora del 2 % del importe vencido.
description: The Lender's right to declare the whole outstanding balance immediately due (acceleration) has been removed. This is an error.

text: El presente Contrato de Préstamo Empresarial a Corto Plazo se suscribe el 9 de febrero de 2026 entre Harbourline Capital Ltd. (el «Prestamista») y Verdant Kitchenware S.L. (el «Prestatario»), representada por su administradora, Elena Marquez.
description: "se celebra" has been replaced with its synonym "se suscribe". The meaning is identical. This is not an error.

text: El presente Contrato se regirá por la legislación española, y cualquier controversia que se derive del mismo se someterá a los juzgados y tribunales competentes de Madrid.
description: "derivada del mismo" has been rephrased as "que se derive del mismo". The meaning is identical. This is not an error.

text: Le principal restant dû portera intérêt à un taux annuel fixe de 7,25 %, calculé sur la base d'une année de 360 jours et couru quotidiennement à compter de la date de signature du présent Contrat.
description: The start date for interest has moved from the date of disbursement to the date of signing. This is an error.

text: L'Emprunteur pourra rembourser par anticipation tout ou partie du prêt à tout moment sans pénalité, à condition que le Prêteur l'en informe par écrit au moins 15 jours à l'avance.
description: The notice obligation has been reversed. Under the rewrite, the Lender must notify the Borrower, whereas the original requires the Borrower to notify the Lender. This is an error.

text: Le présent Contrat de prêt professionnel à court terme est conclu le 9 février 2026 entre Harbourline Capital Ltd. (le « Prêteur ») et Verdant Kitchenware S.L. (l'« Emprunteur »), représentée par son actionnaire majoritaire, Elena Marquez.
description: "gérante" (managing director) has been replaced with "actionnaire majoritaire" (majority shareholder). This changes the capacity in which the signatory represents the company. This is an error.

text: Le Prêteur s'engage à avancer à l'Emprunteur un montant en principal de 85 000,00 EUR, qui sera versé en un seul virement sur le compte bancaire désigné par l'Emprunteur dans un délai de 5 jours ouvrables à compter de la signature du présent Contrat. Aucuns frais de dossier ne seront facturés à l'Emprunteur.
description: A sentence has been added waiving arrangement fees. It is not in the source. This is an error.

text: Le présent Contrat est régi par le droit espagnol.
description: The jurisdiction clause submitting disputes to the courts of Madrid has been deleted. This is an error.

text: L'Emprunteur remboursera le prêt en 6 mensualités égales de 14 500,00 EUR chacune, principal et intérêts compris, la première mensualité arrivant à échéance le 31 mars 2026 et la dernière le 31 août 2026.
description: "étant exigible" has been changed to "arrivant à échéance". The meaning is identical. This is not an error.

text: Le Prêteur s'engage à avancer à l'Emprunteur un montant en principal de 85 000,00 EUR, qui sera versé en un seul virement sur le compte bancaire désigné par l'Emprunteur sous 5 jours ouvrables à compter de la signature du présent Contrat.
description: "dans un délai de" has been replaced with the equivalent "sous". The meaning is identical. This is not an error.

text: Bleibt eine Rate länger als 10 Tage nach ihrem Fälligkeitsdatum unbezahlt, zahlt der Darlehensnehmer einen Verzugszuschlag in Höhe von 2 % des überfälligen Betrags, und der Darlehensgeber muss den gesamten ausstehenden Restbetrag sofort fällig stellen.
description: "kann" (may) has been changed to "muss" (must). This turns the Lender's discretionary right of acceleration into an obligation. This is an error.

text: Der Darlehensnehmer kann das Darlehen jederzeit ganz oder teilweise gegen Zahlung einer Vorfälligkeitsentschädigung vorzeitig zurückzahlen, sofern er dies dem Darlehensgeber mindestens 15 Tage im Voraus schriftlich mitteilt.
description: "ohne Vorfälligkeitsentschädigung" (without penalty) has become "gegen Zahlung einer Vorfälligkeitsentschädigung" (against payment of a penalty). This is an error.

text: Der Darlehensgeber verpflichtet sich, dem Darlehensnehmer einen Darlehensbetrag von 85.000,00 EUR zur Verfügung zu stellen, der innerhalb von 5 Kalendertagen nach Unterzeichnung dieses Vertrags in einer einzigen Überweisung auf das vom Darlehensnehmer benannte Bankkonto ausgezahlt wird.
description: "Geschäftstagen" (business days) has been replaced with "Kalendertagen" (calendar days). This is an error.

text: Dieser Vertrag unterliegt spanischem Recht, und alle sich daraus ergebenden Streitigkeiten werden den zuständigen Gerichten in Madrid vorgelegt. Der Darlehensgeber ist zudem berechtigt, Klage am Sitz des Darlehensnehmers zu erheben.
description: A sentence has been added giving the Lender an additional choice of forum. It is not in the source. This is an error.

text: Der Darlehensnehmer zahlt das Darlehen in 6 gleichen monatlichen Raten von je 14.500,00 EUR zurück, wobei die erste Rate am 31. März 2026 und die letzte Rate am 31. August 2026 fällig wird.
description: The clause "einschließlich Tilgung und Zinsen" (including principal and interest) has been removed. It is now unclear whether interest is included in the instalments. This is an error.

text: Dieser kurzfristige Geschäftsdarlehensvertrag wird am 9. Februar 2026 zwischen Harbourline Capital Ltd. (der „Darlehensgeber“) und Verdant Kitchenware S.L. (der „Darlehensnehmer“), vertreten durch ihre Geschäftsführerin Elena Marquez, abgeschlossen.
description: "geschlossen" has been changed to its synonym "abgeschlossen". The meaning is identical. This is not an error.

text: Der ausstehende Darlehensbetrag wird mit einem festen Jahreszinssatz von 7,25 % verzinst, der auf Basis eines Jahres mit 360 Tagen berechnet wird und vom Tag der Auszahlung an täglich anfällt.
description: "ab dem Tag der Auszahlung" has been rephrased as "vom Tag der Auszahlung an". The meaning is identical. This is not an error.
